prompt:
Use this licensed reference car for the identity and equipment of a photorealistic Russian-market Volkswagen Polo four-door sedan from the original 2009–2015 phase. Create one new balanced front three-quarter view between a front one-third and front one-half view, with the nose pointing left. Keep the full ordinary sedan body, separate trunk and long rear-quarter window through a single coherent camera. Do not change it into a hatchback, facelift, GTI, Vento front or another market’s bumper.

Keep the actual glossy white body paint, black unpainted plastic door handles and normally outward black plastic mirrors, retaining their unpainted surface appearance. Keep the actual silver radial plastic wheel covers with VW centers and whole rubber tires, not upgraded alloy wheels. Retain the near-side front and rear black window rain visors, their actual shape, and the small original red/clear rectangular fender marking in its original position without inventing a new badge. Keep the large three-dimensional chrome VW grille roundel, two thin bright horizontal grille bars, original clear reflector headlights and the broad plain black lower intake. The lower outer corners have horizontal ribbed blank panels and NO fog lamps: keep them blank, with no catalog round fog lamps or facelift three-bar bumper. Preserve the plain source-visible roof contour without inventing a rod, fin, stub, roof rails, crossbars or sunroof.

Preserve the car’s shape, physical accessories, white paint and real material finish, while changing the reflected scene. Remove every recognizable apartment building, window grid, fence, foliage, people, neighboring car, paving pattern and dramatic cloud-scene reflection from its paint, windows and mirrors. Replace those scene mappings with clean, nonrecognizable soft studio highlights. Keep the white paint glossy with natural polished transitions, and keep the black plastic parts naturally unpainted; do not make the body matte, satin, grey, or flat white. Remove the actual background, street and curb. Clear license plate characters, flags and dealer lettering while retaining a plain light plate and frame of the actual shape. Keep the factory VW emblems, quiet clean windows and a coherent empty left-hand-drive cabin.

Deliver the entire car on true transparent RGBA. All tires, mirrors, rain visors, roof and bumper corners must be completely inside the frame. Leave at least 80 pixels of transparent space above and on either side and 100 pixels below the tires, with the car about 78 percent of the canvas width. No floor, cast or contact shadow, halo, checkerboard, text, watermark or caption. No numerical body stretching, changed ride height or invented equipment. The commercial no-fog photograph is identity evidence only and is not a generation input.
